text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hearing that from you two<n>really makes me
feel like a proper<n>Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? Of course<n>you're a proper
member of the<n>Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You gotta own it—let<n>everybody know
you're a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I should own it? I never really saw it<n>that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Guess I better start saying stuff like,<n>"There's no
better cure for fatigue<n>than sweets," or "I wanna fall
in love<n>like the heroine of a romance manga!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
That has nothing to do with being a<n>Mejiro! That's
not what being a<n>Mejiro's about!
